native.legacy_wide_masks_base_gap: An old stored 15m candle does not prove that its constituent closed 1m candles exist.
native.base_refill_blocked_by_missing_analyzed_: A missing analyzed 15m frame must not prevent submitting a metered closed-1m history request; prove request, durable refill and an original decision in the same test window.
native.historic_minutes_not_saved: Every admitted closed 1m candle and its derived bars persist atomically; raw conflicts must not partially write.
native.direct_wide_data_fetch: Both backfill and live refresh use only closed 1m; derive wider bars locally.
native.partial_checkpoint: Repair a partial checkpoint and deliver an actual original-strategy decision in the same window.
native.blank_checkpoint: An unseen candidate can rebuild from no saved state and reach the original strategy.
native.stale_checkpoint: An unusably old checkpoint uses the cold path with measured needs, not listing-day history.
native.independent_delivery: An unready candidate does not block ready peers or delay same-window delivery behind a fixed timer.
native.unicode_symbol: Preserve a valid Unicode contract ID from intake through the original market-data request.
native.reviewed_history_preserved: Preserve previously reviewed historical corrections and original strategy filters.
native.exact_package_and_entry: The tested immutable final image and effective launch match, without mounts shadowing packaged code.
